instruction: A candid action photograph captured from a full shot at eye-level shows a martial arts dojo with yellow walls and a red and blue mat floor. On the left, the woman in the black martial arts uniform with a red belt (R2) lunges forward to the right, extending her right arm in a strike. On the right, the man in the black martial arts uniform with white stripes (R1) stands in a defensive stance, facing left, blocking her strike with his raised left arm. In the far left background, a blurred bystander in dark clothing stands watching. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead indoor lighting, highlighting the warm yellow walls and vibrant floor mats.
